2. MRI of the brain and entire spine

brain MRI: restricted diffusion with matching T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right caudate, anterior lentiform nucleus, cingulate gyrus and insula, and less prominently the right frontal, parietal and temporal cortex
MRI cervical and thoracic spine: normal
